draw: Two bags. Every boss appears before any repeats; the order differs each cycle.
rule: Bosses are deliberately different SHAPES, not bigger numbers. Each carries a note that prints when it rises.
uniques: Rare modified versions of the EIGHT lords - never new lords. Each keeps its lord's shape and twists it: a different behaviour, with its stats skewed to match (lower hp for a faster one, and so on), never just a bigger number. 'shape' names the modifier and what it does.

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Thrice-Kindled
lesser_uniques.shape: its cold fire clings - the ground it crosses stays burning behind it

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Guttered
lesser_uniques.shape: its fire burnt low - quicker and desperate, it strikes twice and fades fast

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Overfull
lesser_uniques.shape: no bigger than the base wall, but she never stops spilling brood - it keeps replacing itself

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Split
lesser_uniques.shape: cut in two and still coming - each half a smaller wall that births its own

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Unburdened
lesser_uniques.shape: sheds its dead early and often - a thinning crowd that will not thin

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, the Famished
lesser_uniques.shape: faster and frailer - it swoops twice before you hear the first

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Roosted
lesser_uniques.shape: slower, heavier, and it never comes alone - the dark around it is all wings

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Marshalled
lesser_uniques.shape: it keeps its dead close - fewer drop, but those that stand hold a line

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Ashbound
lesser_uniques.shape: no clinging fire, just a cold that never lifts - slower and relentless

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Hollowed
lesser_uniques.shape: her brood gone and nothing left to spill - a wall that only holds, and holds

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Starved
lesser_uniques.shape: thin for a wall and far too quick - what little brood she has comes hungry

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Silent
lesser_uniques.shape: no rattle at all - the crowd is on you before the floor says so

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Broken-Winged
lesser_uniques.shape: grounded and furious - it cannot swoop, so it will not let go

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Unmade
lesser_uniques.shape: it comes apart as it fights, and every piece of it is still burning

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Lamp-Drawn
lesser_uniques.shape: it will not leave the light - it circles the lamps and strikes whoever carries one

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Bellbound
lesser_uniques.shape: it keeps time with a bell nobody can find - the crowd moves all at once or not at all

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Crowned Twice
lesser_uniques.shape: two cold crowns and no head worth the name - it fights as though a second king stood beside it

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Walled In
lesser_uniques.shape: she has sealed the room with her own brood - the wall is behind you as well now

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Lampless
lesser_uniques.shape: it puts out every lamp it passes - the rest of the fight happens in the dark it made

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Measured
lesser_uniques.shape: it fights to a count - three steps, three blows, three paces back, and it never miscounts

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Sodden
lesser_uniques.shape: dragged up out of the fen; its fire hisses and will not catch, and it is furious about it

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Fording
lesser_uniques.shape: she has taken the water - the brood comes out of it wet and already moving

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Quiet
lesser_uniques.shape: nothing spills and nothing rattles; the wall simply arrives where you were standing

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Bell-Fed
lesser_uniques.shape: she answers a bell nobody rang - her brood comes in waves, on the count

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Crowned
lesser_uniques.shape: one of its dead wears a crown, and nothing else falls while that one stands

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Pressed
lesser_uniques.shape: too many in too small a room - it cannot swing, so it crushes

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Twinned
lesser_uniques.shape: two shadows and one weight - whichever you strike, the other is already behind you

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Mantled
lesser_uniques.shape: it folds its wings over itself and takes the first blow for nothing

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Banked
lesser_uniques.shape: it keeps its fire low on purpose - it takes everything you give and gives it back in one burn

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Carried
lesser_uniques.shape: its crown rides on one of its own dead - put that one down and the fire simply moves

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Rung Down
lesser_uniques.shape: it fights to a bell it hates - every toll staggers it, and it comes back worse

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Scoured
lesser_uniques.shape: the scarstorm stripped the fire off it - nothing burns now, and everything cuts

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Nesting
lesser_uniques.shape: she will not advance a step - everything she makes comes to you instead

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Shorn
lesser_uniques.shape: her brood cut away before she rose - lighter than a wall and far too quick for one

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Carrying
lesser_uniques.shape: she keeps her mouth shut and spills nothing - until she falls, and then it all comes at once

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Winter-Fat
lesser_uniques.shape: slow, swollen and cold through - her brood comes out of her already freezing

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Widowed
lesser_uniques.shape: nothing in it stands twice - it spends itself fast and fights like it knows

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Processional
lesser_uniques.shape: it comes one at a time, in a line, and the line does not end

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Armoured
lesser_uniques.shape: it wears what the floor left behind - slower, and nothing gets through the front rank

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Smoke-Blind
lesser_uniques.shape: it cannot find you - it strikes where you were and wrecks the room doing it

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Carrion-Heavy
lesser_uniques.shape: it will not drop what it is carrying, so it fights you one-clawed and furious

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Belfried
lesser_uniques.shape: it fights from the dark overhead and only comes down for the bell

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Snuffed
lesser_uniques.shape: its fire out entirely - cold, heavy and silent, and it will not be found by light

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Twice-Lit
lesser_uniques.shape: two fires in one crown - it burns one rank while the other is still choosing

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Fordbound
lesser_uniques.shape: it drags the Ford's water with it - the floor goes to mud and nobody keeps their feet

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Famined
lesser_uniques.shape: nothing left to spill - she comes herself, and she is quick about it

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Crowned in Brood
lesser_uniques.shape: the brood rides her - cut her and you fight what falls off

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Toll-Fed
lesser_uniques.shape: fat on what the scar took in tolls - a wall that advances

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Scattered
lesser_uniques.shape: it comes from four doorways at once and none of them are the one you watched

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Chained
lesser_uniques.shape: bound shoulder to shoulder - it cannot flank, and it cannot be broken either

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Lampbearing
lesser_uniques.shape: it carries the light itself, so the room moves when it moves

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Grounded
lesser_uniques.shape: it will not leave the floor - slower, but everything it hits goes down with it

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Thin-Boned
lesser_uniques.shape: barely there - it dies to a good swing and almost never takes one

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Mourning
lesser_uniques.shape: it circles one fallen thing and savages anything that comes near it

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Half-Woken
greater_uniques.shape: only half risen - slower and softer in the body, but its breath comes deep and ill-tempered

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Unending
greater_uniques.shape: it raises its bones faster than any party can lay them down

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Stripped
greater_uniques.shape: its ward broken - lighter and quicker, and it swings for the throat now

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Unmasked
greater_uniques.shape: no patience left - she opens throats on the first pass and does not curtsy

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, the Deep Freeze
greater_uniques.shape: frost in sheets and the whole floor going to ice - everything slows but it

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Wakeful
greater_uniques.shape: fully roused - no slower, but the breath comes with no warning at all

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Gracious
greater_uniques.shape: all courtesy - she lets you come to her, slower, then opens the throat

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Thawing
greater_uniques.shape: its frost failing - softer and faster, lashing out as the ice cracks

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Coiled
greater_uniques.shape: it never leaves its ring - everything must come to the breath instead

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Kneeling
greater_uniques.shape: it spends its own ward to raise two at a time - unguarded, and never alone

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, in Mourning
greater_uniques.shape: veiled and slow, and every blow she lands grieves whoever stands nearest

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Unspooled
greater_uniques.shape: its coils apart and striking from three sides of the room, each one thinner

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Counting
greater_uniques.shape: it raises the party's own dead first, and takes its time over each one

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Still
greater_uniques.shape: it does not move at all - the cold does the moving, and the room keeps shrinking

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Scar-Fed
greater_uniques.shape: the ground feeds it - every spell cast on this floor comes back out of its mouth

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Attended
greater_uniques.shape: she never fights first and never alone - the room is full of borrowed hands

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Toll-Taking
greater_uniques.shape: it will not touch empty hands - whoever carries the most is the one it takes

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Shedding
greater_uniques.shape: it leaves its skin behind in the corridor, and the skin keeps coming

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Walled
greater_uniques.shape: it builds instead of raising - a bone wall across the room, and it works behind it

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Lamplit
greater_uniques.shape: it carries its own light and will not fight outside it; step out and it rebuilds

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Hosting
greater_uniques.shape: she receives one at a time, and the rest of the room cannot reach her

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Thirsting
greater_uniques.shape: every throat she opens puts her further from dying

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Bound
greater_uniques.shape: iced to the floor it chose - it cannot follow, and nothing leaves the room either

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Hunting
greater_uniques.shape: the frost goes down the corridor first and it comes in behind the cold

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Fasting
greater_uniques.shape: it will not breathe at all - everything it has gone into the body, and the body is quick

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Burrowed
greater_uniques.shape: it fights from under the floor - only the breath comes up, and it comes up anywhere

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Twice-Fed
greater_uniques.shape: heavy with what it ate - slower than it has ever been, and the breath lasts twice as long

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Inventoried
greater_uniques.shape: it raises nothing it has not counted first - slow to start, and then it does not stop

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Hollowed
greater_uniques.shape: it has spent its own bones - brittle and quick, and it raises three where it raised one

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Patient
greater_uniques.shape: it raises nothing until someone falls - and then it raises everything in the room

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Unattended
greater_uniques.shape: no borrowed hands left - she does all of it herself, and she is fast about it

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Veiled
greater_uniques.shape: she takes nothing on the first pass - the first pass is her looking at you

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Invited
greater_uniques.shape: she will not strike whoever has not drawn - everyone else, all at once

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Rimed
greater_uniques.shape: armoured in its own frost - slow, heavy, and nothing lands clean through it

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Shivering
greater_uniques.shape: the cold comes off it in pulses now, and between them it is only a snake

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Drawn Thin
greater_uniques.shape: stretched the length of the room, cold at both ends and thin in the middle

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Toothless
greater_uniques.shape: the breath is gone - so it coils and crushes instead, and it is patient about it

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Surfacing
greater_uniques.shape: it comes up where it likes - no approach, no warning, no front rank

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Brooding
greater_uniques.shape: it will not leave its length of floor, and nothing crosses that floor

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Scattered
greater_uniques.shape: its bones work apart from it - half the room is fighting the other half of him

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Crowned
greater_uniques.shape: it raises one great thing instead of many small - and stands back while it works

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Measured
greater_uniques.shape: it takes exactly as many as it loses, never more - a fight that will not shrink

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Widowed
greater_uniques.shape: no court left - she fights alone and fast, and she is worse for it

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Crowned in Frost
greater_uniques.shape: she borrows Mourncoil's cold and spends it in single, deliberate strikes

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Counting
greater_uniques.shape: she strikes the healthiest in the room, every time, and keeps count aloud

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Guttering
greater_uniques.shape: the cold fails and returns - between failures it is fast, and it knows it

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Shoaled
greater_uniques.shape: it fights in lengths, never all at once - break one and another is already cold

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Doorbound
greater_uniques.shape: it holds the way out and nothing else - leave it be and it will let you work
